citations.claim: first controller_force_limit violation occurs at step 1 with force 6.5 exceeding fmax 5
system energy at violating step reflects uncontrolled controller work

counterfactual.change: set controller noise 1 -> 0, keeping kp=100 fmax=5 vcmd=20 identical; force stays within limit so violation disappears

explanation: Seeded sensor noise is applied to the velocity-error law after the fmax clamp (or added to the commanded force), so with kp=100/vcmd=20 the noisy command reaches 6.5 exceeding fmax=5 at step 1. Removing noise leaves the nominal command within limit, proving noise path bypasses the limiter.
vision_note: The controller-driven (red) body starts on the left side while its green waypoint sits far away in the top-right, demanding a large initial drive force. From step 0 to step 1 the body shows almost no displacement, so the excessive commanded force is not visible as motion but the geometry is consistent with an immediate force-limit exceedance.
